turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to choose how to learn Spanish this year, and I'd love some advice.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first option is an evening class at the community college, twice a week, for about three hundred dollars.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's an app subscription, which is cheap and I could do it on my commute.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a two-week immersion trip to Mexico, living with a host family.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So those are the options. What's your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd combine them if you can. Use the app daily for vocabulary, and pick the class for speaking. The trip makes a great goal for later in the year.
